findings.value: An open-air bar and social space in the Truman Brewery, with a terrace, a garden and an indoor hall that has a dancefloor and a live stage.

evidence.quote: A spacious warehouse-style hideaway featuring a large bar, inviting dancefloor, and live stage.
An alfresco sundeck complete with its own outdoor bar, perfect for summer sessions
A New Social Space at the Heart of Truman Brewery

findings.value: Its events page lists live music, big-screen screenings, quiz nights, themed parties and game nights.

evidence.quote: From live music and big-screen screenings to quiz nights, themed parties, game nights and one-off events

notes: Own site read (home, about, special events). Its events page lists one dated party with a DJ; that is one event, so it is not used for music. No review or press article found in one WebSearch (results were about the Truman Brewery's history). No status news; the site lists bookings and events.
